title: Student Data Access Audit Event
description: Hash-chained append-only ledger event describing which AI tool read which student record, when, under what FERPA disclosure exception (or COPPA consent basis for under-13), under which buyer-published Decision Card, and under what records-of-disclosure obligation status. Bridges CEDS / Ed-Fi resource semantics to the Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite audit-stream spine.

event_id.description: UUID v7 or similar monotonic ID

source.description: The system that emitted the event (e.g. 'springfield-sis-powerschool', 'vendory-tutorai-3.4')

value.description: Tokenized or hashed identifier — RAW state-student-id MUST NOT appear in the event

ceds_element_id.description: CEDS Element ID (e.g. 000234) for fine-grained categorization

id_tokenized.description: Tokenized resource ID — raw IDs MUST NOT appear in the event

action.description: Action codes: C = Create, R = Read, U = Update, D = Delete, E = Execute

outcome.description: Outcome codes: 0 = success, 4 = minor failure, 8 = serious failure, 12 = major failure

ai_tool_card_url.description: URL to the AI tool's Agent Card or MCP Tool Card

ai_decision_card_url.description: URL to the Decision Card that authorized this access

principal.description: OPTIONAL — actor on whose behalf the AI tool acted (teacher, student, counselor, parent)

consent_record_uri.description: OPTIONAL — URL to the consent record if applicable

decision_card_ref.description: URL to the Decision Card that authorized this access (mirrors agent.ai_decision_card_url)

logged_in_99_32.description: Whether this access was logged in the LEA's 34 CFR §99.32 records-of-disclosure (school-official-exception accesses are typically NOT logged per §99.32(d)(2))

carveout_reason.description: OPTIONAL — citation for why this access is not logged (e.g. 'school-official-exception per §99.32(d)(2)')

purpose_of_use.description: Free-text purpose statement (e.g. 'personalized tutoring next-problem generation')

redaction_applied.description: Which fields were tokenized / hashed / redacted per the Decision Card's vault contract before reaching the AI tool

source_ip_hashed.description: Hashed source IP (raw IP MUST NOT appear)
